serverApp.title: Adventure Keeper Serveur
serverApp.intro: The live session server, on the GM's computer. Tokens, HP and the fight move continuously for everyone; players have nothing to install.
serverApp.onComputer: To install on the GM's computer, the one that starts the session.
serverApp.unsigned: The app is not signed yet: the system asks for a confirmation the first time.
serverApp.launchMac: macOS: open the app once, then System Settings → Privacy & Security → “Open Anyway”.
serverApp.launchLinux: Linux: make the AppImage executable (right click → Properties, or chmod +x), or install the .deb.
serverApp.step1: Launch Adventure Keeper Serveur: it shows “Server ready” and an https address.
serverApp.step2: On the adventure's page, open the server button next to “Start session”: the address is found on its own.
serverApp.step3: Start the session. The address changes each time the app starts: nothing to remember.
serverApp.keepOpen: Keep the window open and the computer online until the session ends: closing it stops the server. Nothing is lost, the table waits for it to come back.
